description: Searches Cape Winelands wine farms open to visitors. Filter by area, a date and time they must be open, required features (restaurant, kids, dogs, cellar-tour, wheelchair, picnics, organic...), maximum tasting fee, or distance from a point.

features.description: Features a farm must all have, e.g. restaurant, kids, dogs, cellar-tour, wheelchair, picnics, organic

limit.description: Maximum number of farms to return. Default 10

max_tasting_fee.description: Highest tasting fee in rand. Farms with an unknown fee are kept

near.description: Sort by distance from this point, optionally limited to a radius

radius_km.description: Optional: only farms within this many km

name: search_wine_farms
title: Find wine farms to visit
